101	class ContentAddressedStore:
102	    """Multi-tenant key -> content-addressed blob mapping persisted on disk."""
103	
104	    def __init__(self, root):
105	        if not isinstance(root, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)):
106	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid root: %r" % (root,))
107	        self.root = os.path.abspath(os.fspath(root))
108	        self.blobs_dir = os.path.join(self.root, BLOBS_DIRNAME)
109	        self.uploads_dir = os.path.join(self.root, UPLOADS_DIRNAME)
110	        self.index_path = os.path.join(self.root, INDEX_NAME)
111	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
112	        os.makedirs(self.blobs_dir, exist_ok=True)
113	        (self._objects, self._upload_records, self._versioning,
114	         self._versions, self._retention) = self._load_index()
115	        self._uploads = self._load_uploads()
116	
117	    # -- index ---------------------------------------------------------
118	    def _load_index(self):
119	        if not os.path.exists(self.index_path):
120	            return {DEFAULT_TENANT: {}}, {}, {}, {}, {}
121	        try:
122	            with open(self.index_path, "rb") as handle:
123	                document = json.loads(handle.read().decode("utf-8"))
124	        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
125	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: %s" % (exc,))
126	        if not isinstance(document, dict) or not isinstance(document.get("objects"), dict):
127	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: missing objects map")
128	        objects = {DEFAULT_TENANT: self._load_object_map(document["objects"])}
129	        raw_tenants = document.get("tenants", {})
130	        if not isinstance(raw_tenants, dict):
131	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: tenants is not a map")
132	        for tenant, mapping in raw_tenants.items():
133	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or tenant == DEFAULT_TENANT \
134	                    or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
135	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad tenant")
136	            if not isinstance(mapping, dict):
137	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad tenant objects")
138	            objects[tenant] = self._load_object_map(mapping)
139	        records = {}
140	        raw_records = document.get("uploads", {})
141	        if not isinstance(raw_records, dict):
142	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: uploads is not a map")
143	        for session_id, record in raw_records.items():
144	            if not isinstance(session_id, str) or not isinstance(record, dict):
145	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
146	            key = record.get("key")
147	            if not isinstance(key, str):
148	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
149	            tenant = record.get("tenant", DEFAULT_TENANT)
150	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
151	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
152	            records[session_id] = {
153	                "key": key,
154	                "entry": self._validate_entry(key, record.get("entry")),
155	                "tenant": tenant,
156	            }
157	            version_id = record.get("version_id")
158	            if version_id is not None:
159	                if not isinstance(version_id, str) \
160	                        or _VERSION_ID_RE.match(version_id) is None:
161	                    raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
162	                records[session_id]["version_id"] = version_id
163	        versioning = {}
164	        raw_versioning = document.get("versioning", {})
165	        if not isinstance(raw_versioning, dict):
166	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: versioning is not a map")
167	        for tenant, flag in raw_versioning.items():
168	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
169	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad versioning tenant")
170	            if not isinstance(flag, bool):
171	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad versioning flag")
172	            if flag:
173	                versioning[tenant] = True
174	        versions = {}
175	        raw_versions = document.get("versions", {})
176	        if not isinstance(raw_versions, dict):
177	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: versions is not a map")
178	        for tenant, keymap in raw_versions.items():
179	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
180	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad versions tenant")
181	            if not isinstance(keymap, dict):
182	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad tenant versions")
183	            loaded = {}
184	            for key, entries in keymap.items():
185	                if not isinstance(key, str) or not isinstance(entries, list):
186	                    raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad version list")
187	                loaded[key] = [self._validate_version(key, entry)
188	                               for entry in entries]
189	            if loaded:
190	                versions[tenant] = loaded
191	        retention = {}
192	        raw_retention = document.get("retention", {})
193	        if not isinstance(raw_retention, dict):
194	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: retention is not a map")
195	        for tenant, policy in raw_retention.items():
196	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
197	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention tenant")
198	            retention[tenant] = self._validate_policy(policy)
199	        return objects, records, versioning, versions, retention
200	
201	    def _load_object_map(self, mapping):
202	        objects = {}
203	        for key, entry in mapping.items():
204	            if not isinstance(key, str):
205	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: non-string key")
206	            objects[key] = self._validate_entry(key, entry)
207	        return objects
208	
209	    @staticmethod
210	    def _validate_entry(key, entry):
211	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
212	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: entry for %r is not an object" % (key,))
213	        sha, size = entry.get("sha256"), entry.get("size")
214	        content_type = entry.get("content_type")
215	        if not _is_sha256(sha):
216	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad sha256 for %r" % (key,))
217	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
218	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad size for %r" % (key,))
219	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
220	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad content_type for %r" % (key,))
221	        return {"sha256": sha, "size": size, "content_type": content_type}
222	
223	    def _validate_version(self, key, entry):
224	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
225	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: version for %r is not an object" % (key,))
226	        version_id = entry.get("version_id")
227	        if not isinstance(version_id, str) or _VERSION_ID_RE.match(version_id) is None:
228	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad version_id for %r" % (key,))
229	        created_at = entry.get("created_at")
230	        if not isinstance(created_at, str):
231	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad created_at for %r" % (key,))
232	        base = self._validate_entry(key, entry)
233	        return {"version_id": version_id, "sha256": base["sha256"],
234	                "size": base["size"], "content_type": base["content_type"],
235	                "created_at": created_at}
236	
237	    @staticmethod
238	    def _validate_policy(policy):
239	        if not isinstance(policy, dict):
240	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention policy")
241	        loaded = {}
242	        for name in ("max_versions", "max_age_seconds"):
243	            value = policy.get(name)
244	            if value is None:
245	                continue
246	            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
247	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention policy")
248	            loaded[name] = value
249	        if not loaded:
250	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention policy")
251	        return loaded
252	
253	    def _save_index(self):
254	        document = {"version": INDEX_VERSION,
255	                    "objects": self._objects.get(DEFAULT_TENANT, {})}
256	        tenants = {tenant: mapping for tenant, mapping in self._objects.items()
257	                   if tenant != DEFAULT_TENANT and mapping}
258	        if tenants:
259	            document["tenants"] = tenants
260	        if self._upload_records:
261	            records = {}
262	            for session_id, record in self._upload_records.items():
263	                saved = {"key": record["key"], "entry": record["entry"]}
264	                if record["tenant"] != DEFAULT_TENANT:
265	                    saved["tenant"] = record["tenant"]
266	                if record.get("version_id") is not None:
267	                    saved["version_id"] = record["version_id"]
268	                records[session_id] = saved
269	            document["uploads"] = records
270	        if self._versioning:
271	            document["versioning"] = {
272	                tenant: True for tenant in sorted(self._versioning)
273	                if self._versioning[tenant]
274	            }
275	        versions = {tenant: keymap for tenant, keymap in self._versions.items()
276	                    if keymap}
277	        if versions:
278	            document["versions"] = versions
279	        if self._retention:
280	            document["retention"] = self._retention
281	        payload = json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
282	        _atomic_write(self.index_path, payload.encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
283	
284	    # -- validation ----------------------------------------------------
285	    @staticmethod
286	    def _check_tenant(tenant):
287	        if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
288	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid tenant: %r" % (tenant,))
289	        return tenant
290	
291	    @staticmethod
292	    def _check_key(key):
293	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key or "\x00" in key:
294	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid key: %r" % (key,))
295	        if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
296	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid key: %r" % (key,))
297	        return key
298	
299	    @staticmethod
300	    def _check_limit(limit):
301	        if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int):
302	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid limit: %r" % (limit,))
303	        if not 1 <= limit <= MAX_LIMIT:
304	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid limit: %r" % (limit,))
305	        return limit
306	
307	    @staticmethod
308	    def _require_sha(sha256):
309	        if not _is_sha256(sha256):
310	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid sha256: %r" % (sha256,))
311	        return sha256
312	
313	    @staticmethod
314	    def _check_precondition(expected_sha256):
315	        """Normalize an ``expected_sha256`` keyword argument.
316	
317	        Omitted (the ``_MISSING`` sentinel) means no condition; an explicit
318	        ``None`` means the key must not exist; a 64-digit lowercase hex string
319	        means the key must exist with that exact digest. Anything else is an
320	        ``invalid precondition`` error rather than a failed condition.
321	        """
322	        if expected_sha256 is _MISSING:
323	            return _MISSING
324	        if expected_sha256 is None:
325	            return None
326	        if _is_sha256(expected_sha256):
327	            return expected_sha256
328	        raise ObjectStoreError("invalid precondition")
329	
330	    def _precondition_met(self, tenant, key, expected):
331	        """Return whether *key* in *tenant* currently satisfies *expected*."""
332	        entry = self._objects.get(tenant, {}).get(key)
333	        if expected is None:
334	            return entry is None
335	        return entry is not None and entry["sha256"] == expected
336	
337	    # -- object API ----------------------------------------------------
338	    def put(self, key, payload, content_type=None, expected_sha256=_MISSING,
339	            tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
340	        """Store *payload* under *key* in *tenant* and return its metadata.
341	
342	        *expected_sha256* is an atomic precondition on the key's current
343	        digest in the same tenant: omitted leaves the old overwrite
344	        behaviour, an explicit ``None`` requires the key not to exist, and a
345	        64 lowercase hex digest requires the key to exist with exactly that
346	        digest. Content type and other keys are not compared. Objects of
347	        other tenants are never consulted or touched.
348	
349	        When *tenant* has versioning enabled the write also appends an
350	        immutable version to the key's version list, makes it the current
351	        version and includes its ``version_id`` in the returned metadata.
352	        """
353	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
354	        self._check_key(key)
355	        if not isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
356	            raise ObjectStoreError("payload must be bytes")
357	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
358	            raise ObjectStoreError("content_type must be a string or None")
359	        expected = self._check_precondition(expected_sha256)
360	        data = bytes(payload)
361	        sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
362	        entry = {"sha256": sha, "size": len(data), "content_type": content_type}
363	        with self._lock:
364	            if expected is not _MISSING and not self._precondition_met(
365	                    tenant, key, expected):
366	                raise ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")
367	            self._store_blob(sha, data)
368	            self._objects.setdefault(tenant, {})[key] = entry
369	            version_id = None
370	            if self._versioning.get(tenant, False):
371	                version_id = self._append_version(tenant, key, entry)
372	            self._save_index()
373	            result = dict(entry)
374	            if version_id is not None:
375	                result["version_id"] = version_id
376	            return result
377	
378	    def _append_version(self, tenant, key, entry):
379	        """Append a new immutable version for *key* and return its id.
380	
381	        Must be called under the store lock; the caller makes the matching
382	        current-pointer update and saves the index.
383	        """
384	        versions = self._versions.setdefault(tenant, {}).setdefault(key, [])
385	        existing = {version["version_id"] for version in versions}
386	        while True:
387	            version_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
388	            if version_id not in existing:
389	                break
390	        versions.append({
391	            "version_id": version_id,
392	            "sha256": entry["sha256"],
393	            "size": entry["size"],
394	            "content_type": entry["content_type"],
395	            "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
396	        })
397	        return version_id
398	
399	    def _store_blob(self, sha, data):
400	        """Write the blob for *sha* when missing and repair it when corrupted.
401	
402	        An existing file is hashed on every put. Intact files are left exactly
403	        as they are so dedup costs nothing extra; a file whose digest no longer
404	        matches is rewritten atomically from the complete *data*, so an
405	        interrupted repair leaves either the old bytes or the full new bytes.
406	        """
407	        path = os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, sha)
408	        if os.path.exists(path):
409	            try:
410	                with open(path, "rb") as handle:
411	                    stored = handle.read()
412	            except FileNotFoundError:
413	                stored = None
414	            except OSError:
415	                raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
416	            if stored is not None:
417	                if hashlib.sha256(stored).hexdigest() == sha:
418	                    return
419	                try:
420	                    _atomic_write(path, data)
421	                except OSError:
422	                    raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
423	                return
424	        try:
425	            _atomic_write(path, data)
426	        except OSError:
427	            raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
428	
429	    def get(self, key, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
430	        """Return ``(payload, entry)`` for *key* in *tenant*."""
431	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
432	        with self._lock:
433	            entry = self.head(key, tenant=tenant)
434	            data = self.blob(entry["sha256"])
435	            if len(data) != entry["size"]:
436	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted blob")
437	            return data, entry

439	    def head(self, key, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
440	        """Return a copy of the metadata entry for *key* in *tenant*."""
441	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
442	        self._check_key(key)
443	        with self._lock:
444	            entry = self._objects.get(tenant, {}).get(key)

449	    def delete(self, key, expected_sha256=_MISSING, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
450	        """Drop *key* in *tenant*; shared blobs stay on disk for other keys.
451	
452	        With *expected_sha256*, deletion also requires the key's current
453	        digest in this tenant to match (or an explicit ``None`` requires the
454	        key absent); a satisfied absent-condition delete still reports the
455	        key as not found. Objects other tenants keep under the same key are
456	        unaffected.
457	
458	        When *tenant* has versioning enabled and the key has versions, only
459	        the current version is removed: the newest remaining version becomes
460	        current, and the key disappears entirely once no version remains.
461	        """
462	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
463	        self._check_key(key)
464	        expected = self._check_precondition(expected_sha256)
465	        with self._lock:
466	            objects = self._objects.get(tenant, {})
467	            if key not in objects:
468	                raise ObjectStoreError("not found: %s" % (key,))
469	            if expected is not _MISSING and not self._precondition_met(
470	                    tenant, key, expected):
471	                raise ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")
472	            versions = self._versions.get(tenant, {}).get(key)
473	            if self._versioning.get(tenant, False) and versions:
474	                versions.pop()
475	                if versions:
476	                    promoted = versions[-1]
477	                    objects[key] = {"sha256": promoted["sha256"],
478	                                    "size": promoted["size"],
479	                                    "content_type": promoted["content_type"]}
480	                else:
481	                    del objects[key]
482	                    self._drop_versions_key(tenant, key)
483	            else:
484	                del objects[key]
485	            self._save_index()

487	    def _drop_versions_key(self, tenant, key):
488	        """Remove *key*'s (empty) version list and prune empty parent maps."""
489	        keymap = self._versions.get(tenant)
490	        if keymap is None:
491	            return
492	        keymap.pop(key, None)
493	        if not keymap:
494	            del self._versions[tenant]

496	    def blob(self, sha256):
497	        """Return the raw bytes stored under digest *sha256*.
498	
499	        The digest of the bytes actually on disk is recomputed on every read,
500	        so truncation, appended bytes and same-length tampering are all
501	        rejected instead of being handed back to the caller.
502	        """
503	        self._require_sha(sha256)
504	        with self._lock:
505	            try:
506	                with open(os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, sha256), "rb") as handle:
507	                    data = handle.read()
508	            except FileNotFoundError:
509	                raise ObjectStoreError("not found: blob %s" % (sha256,))
510	            except OSError:
511	                raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
512	            if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != sha256:
513	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted blob")
514	            return data

518	        with self._lock:
519	            return sorted(name for name in os.listdir(self.blobs_dir) if _is_sha256(name))

523	        return os.path.join(self.uploads_dir, session_id + ".json")

528	    def _load_uploads(self):
529	        uploads = {}
530	        try:
531	            names = os.listdir(self.uploads_dir)
532	        except FileNotFoundError:
533	            return uploads
534	        except OSError:
535	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
536	        for name in sorted(names):
537	            match = _SESSION_META_RE.match(name)
538	            if match is None:
539	                continue
540	            session_id = match.group(1)
541	            if session_id in self._upload_records:
542	                # completed before a crash could clean its files up
543	                self._discard_session_files(session_id)
544	                continue

546	            self._check_part_file(session_id, session["offset"])

550	    def _read_session_meta(self, session_id):
551	        try:
552	            with open(self._session_meta_path(session_id), "rb") as handle:
553	                document = json.loads(handle.read().decode("utf-8"))
554	        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
555	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: %s" % (exc,))
556	        if not isinstance(document, dict):
557	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: not an object")
558	        key = document.get("key")
559	        size = document.get("size")
560	        sha = document.get("sha256")
561	        content_type = document.get("content_type")
562	        offset = document.get("offset")
563	        expected = document.get("expected_sha256", _MISSING)
564	        tenant = document.get("tenant", DEFAULT_TENANT)
565	        try:
566	            self._check_key(key)
567	        except ObjectStoreError:
568	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad key")
569	        if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
570	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad tenant")
571	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
572	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad size")
573	        if not _is_sha256(sha):
574	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad sha256")
575	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
576	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad content_type")
577	        if isinstance(offset, bool) or not isinstance(offset, int) or not 0 <= offset <= size:
578	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad offset")
579	        # Sessions written by older versions have no condition; an explicit
580	        # null requires the key absent, a string requires that digest.
581	        if expected is not _MISSING and expected is not None and not _is_sha256(expected):
582	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad precondition")
583	        return {"key": key, "size": size, "sha256": sha,
584	                "content_type": content_type, "offset": offset,
585	                "expected_sha256": expected, "tenant": tenant}

587	    def _check_part_file(self, session_id, offset):
588	        """Ensure the part file holds exactly the confirmed *offset* bytes.
589	
590	        A crash between the chunk write and the metadata update can leave
591	        unconfirmed bytes behind; they are truncated so recovery sees either
592	        the old progress or a whole confirmed chunk, never a partial one.
593	        """
594	        path = self._session_part_path(session_id)
595	        try:
596	            size_on_disk = os.stat(path).st_size
597	        except FileNotFoundError:
598	            if offset:
599	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: missing data")
600	            try:
601	                with open(path, "wb"):
602	                    pass
603	            except OSError:
604	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
605	            return
606	        except OSError:
607	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
608	        if size_on_disk < offset:
609	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: truncated data")
610	        if size_on_disk > offset:
611	            try:
612	                with open(path, "r+b") as handle:
613	                    handle.truncate(offset)
614	                    handle.flush()
615	                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
616	            except OSError:
617	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

619	    def _save_session(self, session_id, session):
620	        # The default tenant is implicit so older session files stay
621	        # byte-identical; every other tenant is recorded explicitly.
622	        document = {name: value for name, value in session.items()
623	                    if value is not _MISSING
624	                    and not (name == "tenant" and value == DEFAULT_TENANT)}
625	        payload = json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
626	        try:
627	            _atomic_write(self._session_meta_path(session_id),
628	                          payload.encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
629	        except OSError:
630	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

634	            with open(self._session_part_path(session_id), "r+b") as handle:
635	                handle.seek(offset)
636	                handle.write(data)
637	                handle.flush()
638	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
639	        except OSError:
640	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

644	            with open(self._session_part_path(session_id), "rb") as handle:
645	                handle.seek(offset)
646	                return handle.read(length)

676	    def _new_session_id(self):
677	        while True:
678	            session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
679	            if session_id in self._uploads or session_id in self._upload_records:
680	                continue
681	            if os.path.exists(self._session_meta_path(session_id)):
682	                continue

685	    @staticmethod
686	    def _check_session_id(session_id):
687	        if not isinstance(session_id, str) or not session_id:
688	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
689	        return session_id

691	    def _require_active_session(self, session_id, tenant):
692	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
693	        record = self._upload_records.get(session_id)
694	        if record is not None and record["tenant"] == tenant:
695	            raise SessionConflict(
696	                "upload session already completed: %s" % (session_id,))
697	        session = self._uploads.get(session_id)
698	        if session is None or session["tenant"] != tenant:
699	            # Sessions of other tenants are indistinguishable from unknown
700	            # ones: no state or progress leaks across tenant boundaries.
701	            raise ObjectStoreError("unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))

704	    def begin_upload(self, key, size, sha256, content_type=None,
705	                     expected_sha256=_MISSING, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
706	        """Start a resumable upload session and return its unique id.
707	
708	        The key and content type follow the same rules as :meth:`put`, *size*
709	        must be a non-negative integer (booleans excluded) and *sha256* the
710	        64 lowercase hex digits of the full content's digest. Creating a
711	        session changes no object; the session and its progress survive
712	        reopening the data directory. The session belongs to *tenant* for its
713	        whole lifetime: every later operation must name the same tenant.
714	
715	        *expected_sha256* saves the same kind of precondition as :meth:`put`;
716	        it is checked once, atomically with the publish, when the session
717	        completes, never while the session is created or appended to.
718	        """
719	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
720	        self._check_key(key)
721	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
722	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid size: %r" % (size,))
723	        self._require_sha(sha256)
724	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
725	            raise ObjectStoreError("content_type must be a string or None")
726	        expected = self._check_precondition(expected_sha256)
727	        session = {"key": key, "size": size, "sha256": sha256,
728	                   "content_type": content_type, "offset": 0,
729	                   "expected_sha256": expected, "tenant": tenant}
730	        with self._lock:
731	            session_id = self._new_session_id()
732	            try:
733	                os.makedirs(self.uploads_dir, exist_ok=True)
734	                with open(self._session_part_path(session_id), "wb"):
735	                    pass
736	            except OSError:
737	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
738	            try:
739	                self._save_session(session_id, session)
740	            except ObjectStoreError:
741	                self._discard_session_files(session_id)
742	                raise
743	            self._uploads[session_id] = session
744	            return session_id

746	    def upload_status(self, session_id, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
747	        """Return the declaration, received ``offset`` and ``completed`` flag.
748	
749	        Only the session's owning tenant sees it; every other tenant gets
750	        the same ``unknown upload session`` error as for a session that
751	        never existed.
752	        """
753	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
754	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
755	        with self._lock:
756	            record = self._upload_records.get(session_id)
757	            if record is not None:
758	                if record["tenant"] != tenant:
759	                    raise ObjectStoreError(
760	                        "unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
761	                entry = record["entry"]
762	                return {"key": record["key"], "size": entry["size"],
763	                        "sha256": entry["sha256"],
764	                        "content_type": entry["content_type"],
765	                        "offset": entry["size"], "completed": True}
766	            session = self._uploads.get(session_id)
767	            if session is None or session["tenant"] != tenant:
768	                raise ObjectStoreError("unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
769	            return {"key": session["key"], "size": session["size"],
770	                    "sha256": session["sha256"],
771	                    "content_type": session["content_type"],

774	    def append_upload(self, session_id, offset, payload, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
775	        """Append one chunk to *session_id* and return the received length.
776	
777	        A new chunk must start exactly at the current end and may not exceed
778	        the declared total size. A chunk lying fully inside the received
779	        range succeeds without growing when its bytes are identical to what
780	        is stored, and fails otherwise; chunks overlapping the end, chunks
781	        past the end and empty chunks anywhere but at the end all fail.
782	        """
783	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
784	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
785	        if isinstance(offset, bool) or not isinstance(offset, int) or offset < 0:
786	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid offset: %r" % (offset,))
787	        if not isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
788	            raise ObjectStoreError("payload must be bytes")
789	        data = bytes(payload)
790	        with self._lock:
791	            session = self._require_active_session(session_id, tenant)
792	            current = session["offset"]
793	            if offset > current:
794	                raise SessionConflict(
795	                    "append gap: offset %d beyond received %d" % (offset, current))
796	            if not data:
797	                if offset != current:
798	                    raise SessionConflict("empty chunk only at received end")
799	                return current
800	            end = offset + len(data)
801	            if offset < current:
802	                if end > current:
803	                    raise SessionConflict("append overlaps received end")
804	                if self._read_part(session_id, offset, len(data)) != data:
805	                    raise SessionConflict("append conflicts with received bytes")
806	                return current
807	            if end > session["size"]:
808	                raise SessionConflict("append exceeds declared size")
809	            self._write_part(session_id, offset, data)
810	            self._save_session(session_id, dict(session, offset=end))
811	            session["offset"] = end
812	            return end

814	    def complete_upload(self, session_id, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
815	        """Publish the object once the received content matches the declaration.
816	
817	        The total length and the SHA-256 of the full content must match the
818	        declared values (zero-byte objects included); only then is the
819	        session's saved precondition checked against the owning tenant's
820	        object state at publish time and the object published in that
821	        tenant, all as one indivisible step. A failed precondition raises
822	        without changing the object, the session's confirmed bytes or any
823	        blob, so the session can be completed again (or aborted) later.
824	        Repeating a completed call returns the first result without touching
825	        the key again, so later writes or deletes of the key are never
826	        overwritten.
827	        """
828	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
829	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
830	        with self._lock:
831	            record = self._upload_records.get(session_id)
832	            if record is not None:
833	                if record["tenant"] != tenant:
834	                    raise ObjectStoreError(
835	                        "unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
836	                entry = dict(record["entry"])
837	                if record.get("version_id") is not None:
838	                    entry["version_id"] = record["version_id"]
839	                return entry
840	            session = self._uploads.get(session_id)
841	            if session is None or session["tenant"] != tenant:
842	                raise ObjectStoreError("unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
843	            if session["offset"] != session["size"]:
844	                raise SessionConflict(
845	                    "upload incomplete: %d of %d bytes received"
846	                    % (session["offset"], session["size"]))
847	            data = self._read_part(session_id, 0, session["size"])
848	            if len(data) != session["size"]:
849	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
850	            if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != session["sha256"]:
851	                raise SessionConflict("upload hash mismatch")
852	            expected = session.get("expected_sha256", _MISSING)
853	            if expected is not _MISSING and not self._precondition_met(
854	                    tenant, session["key"], expected):
855	                raise ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")
856	            entry = {"sha256": session["sha256"], "size": session["size"],
857	                     "content_type": session["content_type"]}
858	            self._store_blob(session["sha256"], data)
859	            objects = self._objects.setdefault(tenant, {})
860	            previous = objects.get(session["key"], _MISSING)
861	            objects[session["key"]] = entry
862	            version_id = None
863	            if self._versioning.get(tenant, False):
864	                version_id = self._append_version(tenant, session["key"], entry)
865	            record = {"key": session["key"], "entry": dict(entry),
866	                      "tenant": tenant}
867	            if version_id is not None:
868	                record["version_id"] = version_id
869	            self._upload_records[session_id] = record
870	            try:
871	                self._save_index()
872	            except OSError:
873	                del self._upload_records[session_id]
874	                if version_id is not None:
875	                    self._versions[tenant][session["key"]].pop()
876	                    self._drop_versions_key(tenant, session["key"])
877	                if previous is _MISSING:
878	                    del objects[session["key"]]
879	                else:
880	                    objects[session["key"]] = previous
881	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
882	            del self._uploads[session_id]
883	            self._discard_session_files(session_id)
884	            result = dict(entry)
885	            if version_id is not None:
886	                result["version_id"] = version_id
887	            return result

891	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
892	        self._check_session_id(session_id)

896	                if record["tenant"] != tenant:

914	    def collect_garbage(self, dry_run=True):
915	        """Collect unreferenced blobs, previewing by default.
916	
917	        Returns ``{"digests": [...], "bytes": <int>, "dry_run": <bool>}``. The
918	        digests are sorted lexicographically and bytes is the sum of the actual
919	        file sizes; a dry run reports the candidates without touching storage,
920	        an actual run reports the files deleted by that call. Only regular
921	        files directly in the blobs directory whose names are 64 lowercase hex
922	        digits are eligible: subdirectories, symlinks, temporary files and any
923	        other names are left untouched, and symlink targets are never opened.
924	
925	        References are recomputed from the current object index on every
926	        call, across every tenant and including digest sharing between keys.
927	        Blobs referenced by any retained object version or declared by an
928	        incomplete upload session are live as well. The whole operation runs
929	        under the store lock, so blobs published
930	        concurrently stay referenced and candidates that vanished between
931	        the scan and deletion are skipped rather than counted.
932	        """
933	        if not isinstance(dry_run, bool):
934	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid dry_run")
935	        with self._lock:
936	            referenced = {
937	                entry["sha256"]
938	                for objects in self._objects.values()
939	                for entry in objects.values()
940	            }
941	            for keymap in self._versions.values():
942	                for versions in keymap.values():
943	                    for version in versions:
944	                        referenced.add(version["sha256"])
945	            for session in self._uploads.values():
946	                referenced.add(session["sha256"])
947	            try:
948	                names = os.listdir(self.blobs_dir)
949	            except OSError:
950	                raise ObjectStoreError("gc io error")
951	            candidates = []
952	            for name in names:
953	                if not _is_sha256(name) or name in referenced:
954	                    continue
955	                path = os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, name)
956	                try:
957	                    info = os.lstat(path)
958	                except FileNotFoundError:
959	                    continue
960	                except OSError:
961	                    raise ObjectStoreError("gc io error")
962	                if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
963	                    continue
964	                candidates.append((name, info.st_size))
965	            candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
966	            if dry_run:
967	                return {
968	                    "digests": [name for name, _ in candidates],
969	                    "bytes": sum(size for _, size in candidates),
970	                    "dry_run": True,
971	                }
972	            deleted = []
973	            freed = 0
974	            for name, size in candidates:
975	                path = os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, name)
976	                try:
977	                    os.remove(path)
978	                except FileNotFoundError:
979	                    continue
980	                except OSError:
981	                    raise ObjectStoreError("gc io error")
982	                deleted.append(name)
983	                freed += size
984	            return {"digests": deleted, "bytes": freed, "dry_run": False}

986	    def list_objects(self, prefix="", after=None, limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT,
987	                     tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
988	        """Return ``{"items": [...], "next_after": <str|null>}`` for one page.
989	
990	        Only *tenant*'s objects are filtered, paginated and returned, with
991	        the plain object keys as names; a tenant without objects yields an

1	"""Standard-library HTTP front end for :class:`ContentAddressedStore`.
2	
3	Every failure is a single-line JSON body ``{"error": "..."}`` with status 400,

8	optional ``X-Objstore-Tenant`` request header (default ``default``); the blob
9	endpoints stay global and ignore it. The versioning and retention endpoints
10	(``/v1/versioning``, ``/v1/objects/{key}/versions[...]``, ``/v1/retention``
11	and ``/v1/retention/purge``) are tenant-scoped the same way.

246	            if version_id is None:
247	                if method != "GET":
248	                    return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
249	                return self._list_versions(key, query, tenant)
250	            return self._version_item(method, key, version_id, tenant)
251	        store = self.server.store
252	        if method == "PUT":
253	            body = self._read_body()
254	            if body is None:
255	                return self._error(411, "length required")
256	            ContentAddressedStore._check_key(key)
257	            expected = self._precondition_headers()
258	            try:
259	                existing = store.head(key, tenant=tenant)
260	            except ObjectStoreError:
261	                existing = None
262	            entry = store.put(key, body, content_type=self.headers.get("Content-Type"),
263	                              expected_sha256=expected, tenant=tenant)
264	            repeated = existing is not None and existing["sha256"] == entry["sha256"]
265	            body_out = {"key": key, "sha256": entry["sha256"], "size": entry["size"]}
266	            if "version_id" in entry:
267	                body_out["version_id"] = entry["version_id"]
268	            return self._send(200 if repeated else 201, _json_bytes(body_out))
269	        if method == "GET":
270	            data, entry = store.get(key, tenant=tenant)
271	            return self._send(200, data, entry["content_type"] or _DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE,
272	                              self._etag_headers(entry))
273	        if method == "HEAD":
274	            entry = store.head(key, tenant=tenant)
275	            return self._send(200, b"", entry["content_type"] or _DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE,
276	                              self._etag_headers(entry), head_only=True,
277	                              length=entry["size"])
278	        if method == "DELETE":
279	            ContentAddressedStore._check_key(key)
280	            expected = self._precondition_headers()
281	            store.delete(key, expected_sha256=expected, tenant=tenant)
282	            return self._send(204, b"")
283	        return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
284	
285	    # -- resumable upload sessions -------------------------------------
286	    def _read_length_body(self):
287	        """Read a body framed strictly by Content-Length.
288	
289	        Transfer-Encoding wins over every other problem (400); a missing,
290	        non-integer or negative Content-Length is 411; a body that ends
291	        before the declared length is 400. Returns ``(body, (status,
292	        message))`` with the error element ``None`` on success.
293	        """
294	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
295	            self.close_connection = True
296	            return None, (400, "transfer encoding not supported")
297	        raw = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
298	        if raw is None or _DECIMAL_RE.match(raw) is None:
299	            self.close_connection = True
300	            return None, (411, "length required")
301	        length = int(raw)
302	        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
303	        if len(body) != length:
304	            self.close_connection = True
305	            return None, (400, "truncated request body")
306	        return body, None
307	
308	    @staticmethod
309	    def _json_object(body):
310	        """Decode *body* as a UTF-8 JSON object or raise a 400-class error."""
311	        try:
312	            text = body.decode("utf-8")
313	        except UnicodeDecodeError:
314	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: body is not utf-8")
315	        try:
316	            document = json.loads(text)
317	        except ValueError:
318	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: body is not a json document")
319	        if not isinstance(document, dict):
320	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: body must be a json object")
321	        return document
322	
323	    @staticmethod
324	    def _offset_param(query):
325	        """Return the unique non-negative decimal ``offset`` query value."""
326	        params = parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True)
327	        values = params.get("offset")
328	        if values is None or len(values) != 1 or _DECIMAL_RE.match(values[0]) is None:
329	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid offset")
330	        return int(values[0])
331	
332	    def _create_upload(self, tenant):
333	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
334	        if error is not None:
335	            return self._error(*error)
336	        document = self._json_object(body)
337	        allowed = {"key", "size", "sha256", "content_type"}
338	        unknown = set(document) - allowed
339	        if unknown:
340	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: unknown field %r" % (sorted(unknown)[0],))
341	        missing = [name for name in ("key", "size", "sha256") if name not in document]
342	        if missing:
343	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: missing field %r" % (missing[0],))
344	        content_type = document.get("content_type")
345	        # Validate every body value before touching the conditional headers:
346	        # request/body errors keep precedence over precondition errors.
347	        key, size, digest = document["key"], document["size"], document["sha256"]
348	        ContentAddressedStore._check_key(key)
349	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
350	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid size: %r" % (size,))
351	        ContentAddressedStore._require_sha(digest)
352	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
353	            raise ObjectStoreError("content_type must be a string or None")
354	        expected = self._precondition_headers()
355	        session_id = self.server.store.begin_upload(
356	            key, size, digest, content_type=content_type,
357	            expected_sha256=expected, tenant=tenant)
358	        return self._send(201, _json_bytes({"session": session_id}))
359	
360	    def _upload_session(self, method, tail, query, tenant):
361	        # Transfer-Encoding is rejected before method/session validation.
362	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
363	            self.close_connection = True
364	            return self._error(400, "transfer encoding not supported")
365	        session_id, sep, sub = tail.partition("/")
366	        if not session_id:
367	            return self._error(404, "not found")
368	        if not sep:
369	            return self._upload_session_item(method, session_id, query, tenant)
370	        if sub == "complete":
371	            if method != "POST":
372	                return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
373	            return self._complete_upload(session_id, tenant)
374	        return self._error(404, "not found")
375	
376	    def _upload_session_item(self, method, session_id, query, tenant):
377	        store = self.server.store
378	        if method == "GET":
379	            return self._send(200, _json_bytes(
380	                store.upload_status(session_id, tenant=tenant)))
381	        if method == "DELETE":
382	            store.abort_upload(session_id, tenant=tenant)
383	            return self._send(204, b"")
384	        if method != "PUT":
385	            return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
386	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
387	        if error is not None:
388	            return self._error(*error)
389	        offset = self._offset_param(query)
390	        confirmed = store.append_upload(session_id, offset, body, tenant=tenant)
391	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes({"offset": confirmed}))
392	
393	    def _complete_upload(self, session_id, tenant):
394	        # No body is required, but framing headers still have to be sane and
395	        # any declared bytes are drained so the connection can be reused.
396	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
397	            self.close_connection = True
398	            return self._error(400, "transfer encoding not supported")
399	        raw = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
400	        if raw is not None:
401	            if _DECIMAL_RE.match(raw) is None:
402	                self.close_connection = True
403	                return self._error(400, "invalid content length")
404	            length = int(raw)
405	            if length:
406	                drained = self.rfile.read(length)
407	                if len(drained) != length:
408	                    self.close_connection = True
409	                    return self._error(400, "truncated request body")
410	        entry = self.server.store.complete_upload(session_id, tenant=tenant)
411	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(entry))
412	
413	    def _list(self, query, tenant):
414	        params = parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True)
415	        raw_limit = params.get("limit", [str(DEFAULT_LIMIT)])[0]
416	        try:
417	            limit = int(raw_limit)
418	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
419	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid limit: %r" % (raw_limit,))
420	        result = self.server.store.list_objects(
421	            prefix=params.get("prefix", [""])[0],
422	            after=params.get("after", [None])[0] or None,
423	            limit=limit,
424	            tenant=tenant,
425	        )
426	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(result))
427	
428	    # -- versioning and retention ---------------------------------------
429	    def _list_versions(self, key, query, tenant):
430	        params = parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True)
431	        raw_limit = params.get("limit", [str(DEFAULT_LIMIT)])[0]
432	        try:
433	            limit = int(raw_limit)
434	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
435	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid limit: %r" % (raw_limit,))
436	        result = self.server.store.list_versions(
437	            key, after=params.get("after", [None])[0] or None,
438	            limit=limit, tenant=tenant)
439	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(result))
440	
441	    def _version_item(self, method, key, version_id, tenant):
442	        store = self.server.store
443	        if method == "GET":
444	            data, entry = store.get_version(key, version_id, tenant=tenant)
445	            return self._send(200, data,
446	                              entry["content_type"] or _DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE,
447	                              self._etag_headers(entry))
448	        if method == "HEAD":
449	            entry = store.head_version(key, version_id, tenant=tenant)
450	            return self._send(200, b"",
451	                              entry["content_type"] or _DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE,
452	                              self._etag_headers(entry), head_only=True,
453	                              length=entry["size"])
454	        if method == "DELETE":
455	            store.delete_version(key, version_id, tenant=tenant)
456	            return self._send(204, b"")
457	        return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
458	
459	    def _versioning(self, method, tenant):
460	        store = self.server.store
461	        if method == "GET":
462	            return self._send(200, _json_bytes(
463	                {"enabled": store.get_versioning(tenant=tenant)}))
464	        if method != "PUT":
465	            return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
466	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
467	        if error is not None:
468	            return self._error(*error)
469	        document = self._json_object(body)
470	        enabled = document.get("enabled")
471	        if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
472	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid versioning")
473	        store.set_versioning(enabled, tenant=tenant)
474	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes({"enabled": enabled}))
475	
476	    def _retention(self, method, tenant):
477	        store = self.server.store
478	        if method == "GET":
479	            policy = store.get_retention(tenant=tenant) or {}
480	            return self._send(200, _json_bytes({
481	                "max_versions": policy.get("max_versions"),
482	                "max_age_seconds": policy.get("max_age_seconds"),
483	            }))
484	        if method != "PUT":
485	            return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
486	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
487	        if error is not None:
488	            return self._error(*error)
489	        document = self._json_object(body)
490	        max_versions = document.get("max_versions")
491	        max_age_seconds = document.get("max_age_seconds")
492	        store.set_retention(max_versions=max_versions,
493	                            max_age_seconds=max_age_seconds, tenant=tenant)
494	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes({
495	            "max_versions": max_versions,
496	            "max_age_seconds": max_age_seconds,
497	        }))
498	
499	    def _purge_retention(self, tenant):
500	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
501	            self.close_connection = True
502	            return self._error(400, "transfer encoding not supported")
503	        dry_run = True
504	        if self.headers.get("Content-Length") is not None:
505	            body, error = self._read_length_body()
506	            if error is not None:
507	                return self._error(*error)
508	            document = self._json_object(body)
509	            dry_run = document.get("dry_run", True)
510	        result = self.server.store.purge_retention(dry_run=dry_run, tenant=tenant)
511	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(result))
512	
513	    def _blob(self, sha256):
514	        if _SHA256_RE.match(sha256) is None:
515	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid sha256: %r" % (sha256,))
516	        return self._send(200, self.server.store.blob(sha256), _DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE,
517	                          [("X-Content-Sha256", sha256)])
518	
519	
520	class ObjectStoreHTTPServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
521	    """Threading HTTP server carrying a reference to the object store."""
522	
523	    daemon_threads = True
524	    allow_reuse_address = True
525	
526	
527	def create_server(store, host="127.0.0.1", port=8080):
528	    """Bind a new HTTP server for *store*; port 0 picks an ephemeral port."""
529	    if not isinstance(store, ContentAddressedStore):
530	        raise ObjectStoreError("store must be a ContentAddressedStore")
531	    httpd = ObjectStoreHTTPServer((host, port), ObjectStoreHandler)
532	    httpd.store = store
533	    return httpd

"""Command line interface.

``python3 -m objstore --data-dir DIR <serve|put|get|list|delete|gc>``. Each command
prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0 on success, or one line of JSON on
stderr and exits non-zero on failure.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import signal
import sys

from .http_app import create_server
from .store import DEFAULT_LIMIT, ContentAddressedStore, ObjectStoreError

__all__ = ["build_parser", "main"]

DEFAULT_DATA_DIR = "./objstore_data"
EXIT_FAILURE = 2


class _Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    """ArgumentParser that reports usage errors as one line of JSON."""

    def error(self, message):
        _fail(message)
        raise SystemExit(EXIT_FAILURE)


def build_parser():
    parser = _Parser(prog="objstore",
                     description="Content-addressed object storage backend.")
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", default=DEFAULT_DATA_DIR,
                        help="directory holding index.json and blobs (default: %(default)s)")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    serve = sub.add_parser("serve", help="run the HTTP API until SIGINT/SIGTERM")
    serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)

    put = sub.add_parser("put", help="store a local file under a key")
    put.add_argument("--key", required=True)
    put.add_argument("--file", required=True)
    put.add_argument("--content-type", default=None)
    put.add_argument("--tenant", default="default",
                     help="tenant namespace for the key (default: %(default)s)")

    get = sub.add_parser("get", help="write a stored object to a local file")
    get.add_argument("--key", required=True)
    get.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    get.add_argument("--tenant", default="default",
                     help="tenant namespace for the key (default: %(default)s)")

    listing = sub.add_parser("list", help="list object keys in lexicographic order")
    listing.add_argument("--prefix", default="")
    listing.add_argument("--after", default=None)
    listing.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=DEFAULT_LIMIT)
    listing.add_argument("--tenant", default="default",
                         help="tenant namespace to list (default: %(default)s)")

    delete = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a key")
    delete.add_argument("--key", required=True)
    delete.add_argument("--tenant", default="default",
                        help="tenant namespace for the key (default: %(default)s)")

    gc = sub.add_parser("gc", help="garbage-collect unreferenced blobs (preview unless --execute)")
    gc.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true",
                    help="actually delete the candidates instead of previewing them")
    return parser


def _emit(payload):
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()


def _fail(message):
    sys.stderr.write(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": message},
                                sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    sys.stderr.flush()
    return EXIT_FAILURE


def _interrupt(signum, frame):
    raise KeyboardInterrupt


def _cmd_serve(args, store):
    httpd = create_server(store, args.host, args.port)
    host, port = httpd.server_address[0], httpd.server_address[1]
    _emit({"ok": True, "addr": "%s:%d" % (host, port), "data_dir": store.root})
    for name in ("SIGINT", "SIGTERM"):
        signum = getattr(signal, name, None)
        try:
            signal.signal(signum, _interrupt)
        except (TypeError, ValueError, OSError):
            pass
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.25)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()

1	# solo06 - Multi-Tenant Content-Addressed Object Store
2	
3	This repository is a small but real backend skeleton for multi-tenant object
4	storage with content addressing. Every object key maps to the SHA-256 digest of
5	its bytes, blobs are written once under `<data-dir>/blobs/<sha256>` so identical
6	payloads are deduplicated no matter how many keys reference them, and object
7	metadata is kept in `<data-dir>/index.json` and rewritten atomically (temporary
8	file plus `os.replace`) so a crash never leaves a half-written index behind. The
9	same core is exposed three ways: as a Python API (`ContentAddressedStore`), as a
10	standard-library HTTP service, and as a command line tool. It uses only the
11	Python standard library, needs no network access and behaves deterministically,
12	which makes it a suitable frozen baseline for later work on chunked and
13	resumable uploads, object versioning and retention, lifecycle and garbage
14	collection, metadata indexing and listing, quotas and rate limiting, consistent
15	hashing and rebalancing, erasure coding and repair, signed URLs and access
16	control, cross-region replication and end-to-end audit.
17	
18	## Requirements
19	
20	* Python 3.10 or newer (developed and verified on Python 3.12).
21	* No third-party packages, no network access required.
22	
23	## Usage
24	
25	Start the HTTP server (run from the repository root):
26	
27	```
28	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
29	```
30	
31	The server prints one line of JSON before it starts serving, for example
32	`{"addr":"127.0.0.1:8080","data_dir":"/abs/path/objstore_data","ok":true}`, and
33	then runs until it receives SIGINT or SIGTERM.
34	
35	Store and fetch data over HTTP:
36	
37	```
38	printf 'hello' | curl -sS -X PUT --data-binary @- -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
39	  http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/objects/a.txt
40	curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/objects/a.txt
41	curl -sS 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/objects?prefix=&limit=100'
42	```
43	
44	Upload a large payload through a resumable HTTP session:
45	
46	```
47	size=$(wc -c < big.bin)
48	digest=$(sha256sum big.bin | cut -d' ' -f1)
49	session=$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/uploads \
50	  -d "{\"key\":\"docs/big.bin\",\"size\":$size,\"sha256\":\"$digest\"}" \
51	  | sed 's/.*"session":"\([0-9a-f]*\)".*/\1')
52	head -c 1048576 big.bin | curl -sS -X PUT \
53	  "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/uploads/$session?offset=0" --data-binary @-
54	tail -c +1048577 big.bin | curl -sS -X PUT \
55	  "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/uploads/$session?offset=1048576" --data-binary @-
56	curl -sS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/uploads/$session/complete"
57	```
58	
59	Use the command line interface instead of the server:
60	
61	```
62	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data put --key docs/a.txt --file ./a.txt
63	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data get --key docs/a.txt --out ./copy.txt
64	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data list --prefix docs/ --limit 100
65	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data delete --key docs/a.txt
66	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data gc
67	python3 -m objstore --data-dir ./objstore_data gc --execute
68	```
69	
70	The global `--data-dir` option must appear before the subcommand; it defaults to
71	`./objstore_data`. `put`, `get`, `list` and `delete` also accept `--tenant`
72	(default `default`) to pick the tenant namespace. Every command prints exactly
73	one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0 on success, or prints one line of JSON
74	on stderr and exits non-zero on failure.
75	
76	Use the Python API directly:
77	
78	```python
79	from objstore import ContentAddressedStore
80	
81	store = ContentAddressedStore("./objstore_data")
82	entry = store.put("docs/a.txt", b"hello", content_type="text/plain")
83	payload, head = store.get("docs/a.txt")
84	page = store.list_objects(prefix="docs/", after=None, limit=100)
85	result = store.collect_garbage()              # preview only
86	store.collect_garbage(dry_run=False)          # actually delete
87	```
88	
89	### Tenants
90	
91	Every object key lives in a tenant namespace. Two tenants may use the same
92	key for independent objects: reads, writes, deletes, conditional writes and
93	listings of one tenant never see or affect another tenant's objects. Tenants
94	need no provisioning — a tenant exists as soon as it has objects or sessions,
95	and listing a tenant without objects returns an empty page. A tenant name is
96	1–64 characters of lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`, starting with a
97	letter or digit; anything else raises `ObjectStoreError("invalid tenant: ...")`
98	(Python), returns `400 {"error":"invalid tenant ..."}` (HTTP) or the usual
99	CLI failure line with a non-zero exit, and changes no data.
100	
101	The Python API takes an optional `tenant` keyword (default `"default"`) on
102	`put`, `get`, `head`, `delete`, `list_objects` and every upload-session
103	operation:
104	
105	```python
106	store.put("docs/a.txt", b"hello", tenant="acme")
107	payload, head = store.get("docs/a.txt", tenant="acme")
108	page = store.list_objects(prefix="docs/", tenant="acme")
109	session = store.begin_upload("docs/big.bin", size, digest, tenant="acme")
110	```
111	
112	The HTTP object and upload-session endpoints select the tenant through the
113	optional `X-Objstore-Tenant` request header (default `default`); a repeated
114	header or an invalid name returns `400 {"error":"invalid tenant ..."}` and
115	takes precedence over every other request error. The CLI commands `put`,
116	`get`, `list` and `delete` accept an optional `--tenant` flag.
117	
118	A conditional write compares only the digest of the key in the same tenant,
119	and an upload session belongs to the tenant fixed at creation: its status,
120	append, complete and abort operations must name that tenant, and a valid
121	session id of another tenant behaves exactly like an unknown session id
122	(`ObjectStoreError` / `404`) without revealing any state. Blobs stay global —
123	identical content is stored once across all tenants, `blob`/`blob_digests`
124	and `GET /v1/blobs/{sha256}` keep their global meaning, and garbage
125	collection only reclaims content no tenant references anymore. Directories
126	written by older versions (objects, sessions and completion records without
127	tenant information) belong to the `default` tenant after the upgrade.
128	
129	### Conditional writes
130	
131	`put`, `delete` and `begin_upload` take an optional keyword
132	`expected_sha256` that makes the write or delete an atomic compare-and-swap on
133	the target key's current digest:
134	
135	* omitted entirely keeps the original unconditional behaviour;
136	* an explicit `None` requires the key not to exist;
137	* a string of 64 lowercase hex digits requires the key to exist with exactly
138	  that metadata digest.
139	
140	Only that key's digest is compared; the content type and every other key are
141	irrelevant. Any other value raises
142	`ObjectStoreError("invalid precondition")`. When the condition does not hold,
143	the operation raises `ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")` and changes
144	neither the object nor (for uploads) the session progress or any blob; a
145	satisfied absent-condition `delete` still raises the usual
146	`ObjectStoreError("not found: ...")`. The check and the mutation are one
147	indivisible operation under the store lock, so two concurrent writes that
148	both expect the same old digest cannot both succeed.
149	
150	```python
151	store.put("docs/a.txt", b"hello", expected_sha256=None)          # create only
152	store.put("docs/a.txt", b"hello!", expected_sha256=head["sha256"])  # CAS update
153	store.delete("docs/a.txt", expected_sha256=head["sha256"])      # delete if unchanged
154	```
155	
156	For a resumable session the condition passed to `begin_upload` is saved with
157	the session and is not checked while the session is created or appended to;
158	it is evaluated once, atomically with the publish, against the object's state
159	at completion time (after the length and hash checks pass). A failed
160	precondition leaves the confirmed bytes and the incomplete session in place,
161	so it can be completed again or aborted; the condition still applies after
162	reopening the data directory, while session files written by older versions
163	stay unconditional.
164	
165	### Resumable uploads
166	
167	Large or unreliable transfers can be uploaded in chunks through a persistent
168	session instead of a single `put`:
169	
170	```python
171	session = store.begin_upload("docs/big.bin", size, sha256_of_full_content,
172	                             content_type="application/octet-stream")
173	store.upload_status(session)          # {"key","size","sha256","content_type","offset","completed"}
174	store.append_upload(session, 0, first_chunk)      # returns the received length
175	store.append_upload(session, len(first_chunk), second_chunk)
176	entry = store.complete_upload(session)            # publishes, returns put metadata
177	store.abort_upload(session)                       # or drop the session entirely
178	```
179	
180	`begin_upload` validates the key and content type exactly like `put`, requires
181	a non-negative integer `size` (booleans excluded) and the 64 lowercase hex
182	digits of the full content's SHA-256, and returns a unique string session id.
183	Creating a session changes no object, and sessions with their confirmed
184	progress survive reopening the data directory. `append_upload` accepts the
185	same byte types as `put`: a new chunk must start exactly at the current end
186	and may not exceed the declared size; re-sending identical bytes fully inside
187	the received range succeeds without growing, while different bytes, chunks
188	overlapping the received end, gaps and empty chunks anywhere but at the end
189	all raise `ObjectStoreError`. `complete_upload` publishes the object only when
190	the received length and the SHA-256 of the full content match the declaration
191	(zero-byte objects included); until then the key keeps its old value and no
192	new blob appears. Appending after completion fails, repeating a completed
193	`complete_upload` returns the first result without overwriting later writes
194	or deletes of the key, and `abort_upload` removes the session (returning
195	`None`) without deleting any published object. An interrupted append leaves
196	either the old progress or a whole new chunk, and an interrupted complete
197	leaves either the old object or the fully published new one; after recovery
198	the `completed` flag always agrees with what was published. Sessions on the
199	same key are independent and publish in completion order. Garbage collection
200	never touches data needed by incomplete sessions; once a session completes or
201	is aborted, its blob follows the normal object-reference rules and the
202	completion record itself keeps nothing alive. The command line interface is
203	unchanged by this feature; the HTTP session surface is documented below.
204	
205	`collect_garbage(dry_run=True)` returns
206	`{"digests": [...], "bytes": <int>, "dry_run": <bool>}`: the digests sorted
207	lexicographically and the sum of the files' actual byte sizes (zero-byte
208	blobs included). A dry run reports the candidates and changes nothing;
209	`dry_run=False` deletes the candidates and reports what that call removed.
210	References are recomputed from the current index on every call, so content
211	still shared by any key, any retained object version or any incomplete
212	upload session is kept, while content orphaned by an overwrite, by
213	deleting the last reference, or never indexed at all is collectable. Only
214	regular files directly in `blobs/` whose names are 64 lowercase hex digits
215	are eligible; other names, temporary files, subdirectories and symlinks are
216	preserved and symlink targets are never followed. Unreferenced files are
217	deleted without validating their content, and missing or corrupted blobs
218	that are still referenced do not block other candidates. A non-boolean
219	`dry_run` raises `ObjectStoreError("invalid dry_run")`, and any scanning,
220	stating or deletion I/O failure raises `ObjectStoreError("gc io error")`; a
221	failed scan deletes nothing, and a failure mid-deletion leaves the completed
222	deletions in place so a retry collects the rest. Garbage collection runs
223	under the same lock as object reads and writes within one store instance.
224	
225	### Object versioning and retention
226	
227	Versioning is opt-in per tenant and defaults to off; while off, every API,
228	HTTP path and CLI command behaves exactly as before. The toggle only affects
229	new writes — enabling or disabling it never deletes or rewrites existing
230	objects or versions:
231	
232	```python
233	store.set_versioning(True, tenant="acme")        # enable for one tenant
234	store.get_versioning(tenant="acme")              # -> True
235	```
236	
237	While a tenant has versioning enabled, every `put` and every completed
238	resumable upload appends an immutable version (a random 32-hex-digit
239	`version_id`, the content metadata and a UTC `created_at`) to the key's
240	version list and makes it the current version; the returned metadata carries
241	the new `version_id`. `get`, `head` and `list_objects` keep returning only
242	the current version, and `delete` removes only the current version: the
243	newest remaining version is promoted to current, and the key disappears once
244	no version remains. Older versions stay readable and deletable through
245	dedicated calls:
246	
247	```python
248	page = store.list_versions("docs/a.txt", tenant="acme")
249	# {"items": [{"version_id", "sha256", "size", "created_at", "current"}, ...],
250	#  "next_after": <version_id or null>}   — newest first, paginate with after/limit
251	data, entry = store.get_version("docs/a.txt", version_id, tenant="acme")
252	entry = store.head_version("docs/a.txt", version_id, tenant="acme")
253	store.delete_version("docs/a.txt", version_id, tenant="acme")
254	```
255	
256	Version reads verify the blob digest and size exactly like `get`. A malformed
257	`version_id` raises `ObjectStoreError("invalid version")`, an unknown key or
258	version raises `not found`, and calling any of these while the tenant has
259	versioning disabled raises `ObjectStoreError("versioning disabled")`.
260	Deleting a historical version never touches the current object; deleting the
261	current version promotes the newest remaining one.
262	
263	A retention policy is saved per tenant with at least one of two non-negative
264	integer limits — anything else raises `ObjectStoreError("invalid retention")`:
265	
266	```python
267	store.set_retention(max_versions=10, tenant="acme")
268	store.set_retention(max_age_seconds=86400, tenant="acme")
269	store.get_retention(tenant="acme")   # -> {"max_versions":..., "max_age_seconds":...} or None
270	result = store.purge_retention(dry_run=True, tenant="acme")   # preview
271	store.purge_retention(dry_run=False, tenant="acme")           # actually delete
272	```
273	
274	`purge_retention` compares version `created_at` timestamps against the
275	current UTC time and always keeps the current version of every key; of the
276	remaining versions it deletes any beyond the newest `max_versions` per key or
277	older than `max_age_seconds`. It returns
278	`{"versions": [{"key","version_id","sha256","size","created_at"}, ...],
279	"bytes": <int>, "dry_run": <bool>}` with the removed (or, for a dry run,
280	removable) versions sorted by `version_id` and their total size in bytes; a
281	dry run changes nothing, a missing policy yields an empty result, a
282	non-boolean `dry_run` raises `ObjectStoreError("invalid dry_run")` and an
283	I/O failure while saving raises `ObjectStoreError("version io error")`.
284	Purged version blobs stay on disk until `collect_garbage` reclaims them —
285	garbage collection treats blobs referenced by any version, any current
286	object or any incomplete upload session as live.
287	
288	The HTTP surface grows four tenant-scoped endpoints (tenant selected through
289	`X-Objstore-Tenant` as usual): `GET`/`PUT /v1/versioning` reads and sets the
290	tenant's flag with a `{"enabled": <bool>}` body (a non-boolean value returns
291	`400 {"error":"invalid versioning"}`); `GET /v1/objects/{key}/versions`
292	lists versions newest-first as `{"items": [...], "next_after": ...}` with
293	`after`/`limit` pagination, and `GET`/`HEAD`/`DELETE
294	/v1/objects/{key}/versions/{version_id}` reads, inspects or deletes one
295	version (GET carries `X-Content-Sha256` and `ETag` like object GET);
296	`GET`/`PUT /v1/retention` reads and saves the policy as
297	`{"max_versions":..., "max_age_seconds":...}` (invalid input returns
298	`400 {"error":"invalid retention"}`); and `POST /v1/retention/purge` runs
299	the purge with an optional `{"dry_run": <bool>}` body (default `true`), a
300	non-boolean value returning `400 {"error":"invalid dry_run"}`. Object `PUT`
301	and upload completion responses include `version_id` while the tenant has
302	versioning enabled. The command line interface is unchanged by this feature.
